description: Enhance an image or video. Magnific (default) supports configurable scale_factor and creativity; face-enhance for portraits; video-upscaler (FlashVSR, up to 4K) for clips — pass video_url plus video_duration in seconds.

creativity.description: magnific-upscaler only: sent unchanged as its creativity setting, an integer from -10 to 10 (default 0; lower preserves the source, higher invents more detail).

image_url.description: Source image to upscale (image models). A clip URL here (.mp4/.mov/.webm) is treated as video_url.

model.description: Defaults to magnific-upscaler, or video-upscaler when the source is a clip. face-enhance is for portraits.

scale_factor.description: Image models only. magnific-upscaler snaps to the nearest of 2/4/8/16 (default 2); creative-upscale clamps to 1-10 (default 2); face-enhance clamps to 1-8 (default 4).

target_resolution.description: video-upscaler only: output resolution. Defaults to 1080p.

video_duration.description: video-upscaler only, required there: source clip length in seconds. It sets the cost (1 credit per second).

video_url.description: Source video clip (MP4, max 500 MB). Routes to video-upscaler when no model is named; needs video_duration.

name: pixeldojo_upscale
title: Upscale image or video
